tasks.label: build and run
tasks.command: $pid_file = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'capstone_run.pid'; if (Test-Path $pid_file) { $old = Get-Content $pid_file; try { Stop-Process -Id $old -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600 } catch {}; Remove-Item $pid_file }; dotnet build '${workspaceFolder}/CapstoneProject.csproj' /property:GenerateFullPaths=true '/consoleloggerparameters:NoSummary;ForceNoAlign'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $p = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run --no-build --project ${workspaceFolder}/CapstoneProject.csproj' -PassThru -NoNewWindow; $p.Id | Out-File $pid_file; $p.WaitForExit() }
